reviewer_issues.reviewer_concern: Small and unbalanced experience groups limit interaction reliability.
reviewer_issues.action: Supplement low-experience participants and report before/after balance.

reviewer_issues.reviewer_concern: Gender was recorded but not included in the analysis.
reviewer_issues.action: Include Gender in main models and report sensitivity.

reviewer_issues.reviewer_concern: EEG theta/alpha time trends and condition effects may be confounded by trial order or carryover.
reviewer_issues.action: Fit formal block/position EEG models, trial-index condition interactions, and previous-condition carryover sensitivity models.

reviewer_issues.reviewer_concern: Questionnaire-related movement and the short gray interval may contaminate the beginning of the next EEG scene.
reviewer_issues.action: Trim scene onset before PSD/QC and report 0/5/10/15-s window sensitivity plus formal 10-vs-15-s equivalence on the common-QC set.

reviewer_issues.reviewer_concern: Fatigue or attention dispersion across repeated trials may affect questionnaire, eye-tracking, and EEG indicators.
reviewer_issues.action: Report modality-specific order/fatigue-proxy models, FDR, time stability, carryover sensitivity, and bounded limitations.

reviewer_issues.reviewer_concern: Only three WWR levels cannot strongly identify a nonlinear optimum.
reviewer_issues.action: Use trend/planned contrasts and soften optimality claims.
Report AOI area, visited rate, and AOI-level sample coverage.
Generate claim strength table and downgrade weak claims.
